description: This source file defines the RedisStorageOptions class, which encapsulates configuration settings for Redis-based grain storage in an Orleans application. It includes options for connection management, serialization, key generation, and lifecycle. Additionally, it provides extension methods for specific configurations and a redaction attribute for sensitive data.

classes.name: RedisStorageOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for Redis storage, including connection settings, serialization, and key generation.

classes.name: RedisStorageOptionsExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods to configure RedisStorageOptions, such as customizing key formats.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: A class used to redact sensitive information from Redis configuration data.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Creates and returns a Redis connection multiplexer asynchronously based on provided options.
